text:
sam: Quick heads-up — planning a coordinated rollout for runtime, API, console, and router tomorrow 03:00-05:00 UTC. Need final pin order and rollback plan.

maya (runtime-eng): ETA on runtime image?

sam: runtime v2.4.0-rc3 (no model format changes). we want runtime first to warm caches.

raj (api-eng): API depends on runtime kvcache layout change?

maya (runtime-eng): no layout change, only scheduling fixes and better batching. API should be compatible with v2.4.0.

olivia (console-eng): console UI has the new model selector flag; it's backwards compatible but to avoid telemetry spikes would like console after api.

ken (router-eng): router needs the new routing header support in API (X-RI-ModelVariant). can we pin API before router?

sam: proposed order: 1) runtime (canary small pool) 2) api (canary) 3) router (canary + gradual traffic) 4) console (rollout to prod).

dave (sre-oncall): add a middle step: after api canary, run a 10m smoke with end-to-end sampling, check latency and error rate. if errors >1% rollback api.

raj (api-eng): ok. I'll add a health endpoint check and a synthetic test to the canary job.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: runtime v2.4.0-rc3 -> canary at 2024-07-01T03:00Z. owner: maya.

sam: Pinning note — keep runtime pinnings for Dedicated customers locked to v2.3.x for 48h after rollout, we'll only expose v2.4 to Hosted.

olivia (console-eng): console release contains a feature flag to opt into new model selector. I will gate it behind a flag and only enable after router sees <0.5% 5xx.

ken (router-eng): router changes are config and a tiny patch to header parsing (no hot reload). canary will be 5% traffic for 20m then 25% for 20m. rollback if p50 latency +20% sustained.

maya (runtime-eng): runtime canary will be tiny: 6 GPUs, 1 replica per zone. I'll push a canary image and share deploy job link.

raj (api-eng): I'll pin API spec to v1.12.0 in the canary and add compatibility tests. also will add a feature-flag fallback path so router can call older header if needed.

sam: Good. Notes for rollback: runtime -> revert image and clear KV cache; api -> rollback to last stable tag v1.11.7; router -> revert config and route back to legacy header. console -> flag off. owners: maya, raj, ken, olivia.

deploy-bot: canary jobs created: runtime-canary-171980, api-canary-171981.

dave (sre-oncall): I'll be oncall for the window. paging policy: if any region sees >2% 5xx for 5m, page oncall + eng leads.

raj (api-eng): quick question — do we need a DB migration?

maya (runtime-eng): no DB migration. only in-memory layout changes.

olivia (console-eng): one more ask — console release notes should call out the model selector flag and rollback steps. I'll draft notes after we confirm timing.

sam: Ack. I'll update release checklist: preflight (smoke tests good), canary steps, pinning note, rollback runbook, postmortem owner.

ken (router-eng): I volunteer to watch traffic shifts and run quick curl tests during the 25% ramp.

sam: Thanks all. If no objections, I'll flip the scheduled deploy to "execute" at 02:30 UTC. please post any blocker before 02:00. :thumbsup:

olivia (console-eng): :thumbsup: good to me.

maya (runtime-eng): :+1: I'll be ready.

raj (api-eng): :+1: will monitor canary tests.

ken (router-eng): :+1:

deploy-bot: deployment state change: scheduled -> ready_to_execute by sam at 2024-07-01T02:32Z.
